mission.body: Lumi was born from a simple observation: modern travelers are forced to choose between inflated exchange rates, cash or traditional cards, and none of these options are truly satisfactory. Travelers lack access to the most efficient payment method in the region: mobile QR payments.

whyLumi.title: Why Lumi?
whyLumi.body: Lumi is designed to give you complete confidence in every transaction. Founded by experienced bankers and backed by European investors, we bring deep financial expertise and long-term trust to everything we do. As a European company working with regulated partners across Europe and Asia, we meet high standards of security and compliance to protect your funds and money movements. Combined with instant payments, transparent pricing, and a large acceptance network, Lumi delivers a payment experience you can rely on anywhere.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Lumifin ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website <1>www.lumifin.io</1> or use our services.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.body: We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, and any information you provide when registering or contacting us. We also automatically collect technical information including IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, and usage data when you interact with our platform.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.item1: Provide, operate, and improve our services
section2.item2: Communicate with you regarding updates and support
section2.item5: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

section3.title: 3. Data Sharing
section3.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers such as payment partners, analytics providers, and infrastructure vendors solely for the purpose of operating our services, under strict confidentiality agreements.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.body: We use appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or misuse.

section5.title: 5. User Rights
section5.body: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information. You may also withdraw consent where applicable by contacting us.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.body: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law.

section7.title: 7. International Data Transfers
section7.body: Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence, which may have different data protection laws.

section8.title: 8. Updates to This Policy
section8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with a revised effective date.

q1.question: What is Lumi?
q1.answer: Lumi is a digital wallet that lets you pay at local merchants across Southeast Asia using QR codes. You can pay in your own currency while Lumi handles the conversion instantly at checkout.

q2.question: Where can I use Lumi?
q2.answer: Lumi is accepted at millions of merchants across Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia, wherever supported QR payment networks are available.

q3.question: How do I pay with Lumi?
q3.answer: Simply open the app, scan the merchant's QR code, enter the amount if required, and confirm the payment using your secure mPIN or biometric authentication.

q4.question: Do I need to convert currency before paying?
q4.answer: No. Lumi automatically converts your payment into the local currency in real time, so you can pay seamlessly without any manual conversion.

q5.question: What exchange rate does Lumi use?
q5.answer: Lumi shows you the live exchange rate and final amount before you confirm your payment, so you always know exactly what you're paying.

q6.question: Are there any fees?
q6.answer: Lumi is transparent about pricing. Any applicable fees, including currency conversion and payment processing fees, are clearly displayed before you complete a transaction.

q7.question: How do I add money to my Lumi wallet?
q7.answer: You can add funds through supported payment methods directly within the app. Credit tranfers and direct connections with European bank accounts are supported. The process is simple and most deposits are completed instantly.

q8.question: How long do payments take?
q8.answer: Payments are processed in seconds once confirmed, provided you have an active internet connection. You and the merchant receive the payment confirmation in realt time.

q9.question: Is Lumi secure?
q9.answer: Yes. Lumi uses industry-standard security measures, including encryption, identity verification, and secure authentication methods like mPIN and biometrics to protect your account.

q10.question: Why do I need to verify my identity?
q10.answer: Identity verification helps keep your account secure and allows Lumi to comply with financial regulations, ensuring a safe and reliable payment experience.

q11.question: What documents are required for verification?
q11.answer: You'll need to provide a valid government-issued ID, such as a passport or national ID card. In some cases, a selfie may be required for verification.

q12.question: Can I withdraw money from my Lumi wallet?
q12.answer: Yes. You can withdraw funds to a supported bank account or payment method, depending on your location.

q13.question: How long do withdrawals take?
q13.answer: Withdrawal times vary based on the method used, ranging from a few minutes to a few business days.

q14.question: Can I see my transaction history?
q14.answer: Yes. All your payments and transactions are available immediately in the app, so you can track your spending anytime.

q15.question: What happens if I make a wrong payment?
q15.answer: Payments are usually processed instantly and cannot be reversed automatically. If you encounter an issue, you can contact the merchant or Lumi support for assistance.

q16.question: How is my money safeguarded?
q16.answer: Your money is always handled by regulated banking and payment partners — never held directly by Lumi. We work with trusted, licensed institutions across Europe and Asia that follow strict regulatory standards to ensure your funds are protected at every step.

q17.question: Is Lumi a bank?
q17.answer: No, Lumi is not a bank. Lumi is a brand of Lumifin SAS, a technology provider. All payment services and fund movements are carried out by fully regulated partners in Europe and Asia, who are licensed and supervised by financial authorities.
